record.one_liner: Vonage provides a comprehensive suite of communication APIs spanning messaging, voice, video, and network features, enabling developers to integrate multiple channels like SMS, WhatsApp, and voice calls into their applications.

auth_methods.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: API Key and Secret (Header) JSON Web Token (JWT)

access_test.quote: To work with our APIs, you will need to sign up for an account . This will give you an API key and secret that you can use to access our APIs.

access_ship.quote: Access to our APIs is charged on a per-request basis. We’ll give you some free credit when you first open your account and you can top up when you run low.

api_type.quote: Our specifications conform to OpenAPI specification version 3, also known as OAS3.

api_breadth.quote: Messaging Messages API For SMS, MMS, Facebook, WhatsApp, Viber, Email and much more... Voice Voice API Make and receive telephone calls to or from anywhere in the world.

official_mcp.quote: The provided pages make no mention of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or an MCP server.
